packageRules.description: Security-relevant updates: no schedule, no minimum age, auto-merge once CI is green.
OSV-sourced vulnerability advisories for transitive deps too — same auto-merge stance as the npm vulnerabilityAlerts rule above.
Wait a few days before opening a PR for non-security updates, to let obviously broken releases get pulled.
This image only exists to pin the Playwright browser build the kundenportal repo's CI relies on (see README) — never let this drift unreviewed. No auto-merge, even for minor/patch bumps.
Group pnpm version bumps (packageManager field + lockfile).
Group GitHub Actions used by the build workflow.

Base runner image (myoung34/github-runner) — digest-only bumps, since 'ubuntu-noble' is a rolling tag with no semver. A digest bump is the signal that upstream refreshed OS packages/security patches; each one triggers a rebuild via the paths filter on Dockerfile.runner.
Auto-merge patch/minor devDependency bumps once CI is green — low risk, keeps PR volume down. Excludes the Playwright pin (handled above) and major bumps (handled below).
GitHub Actions: keep pinned to digests but let patch/minor/digest tag bumps auto-merge.
Never auto-merge major bumps — always needs a human look (e.g. a Node major bump, or the base image switching Ubuntu release).
Node engines pinned intentionally (kundenportal ADR-016 stack must match) — review manually, don't auto-bump majors silently.
